architecture: Static Vite-served single-page application with a pure calculation/state core separated from DOM orchestration.

files.purpose: pure weighted-score, timer formatting, receipt and rationale functions
DOM binding, countdown state machine, locking, receipt rendering and clipboard behavior
deterministic core and static acceptance tests

reuseDecision: Reuse existing repository Vite build and Vercel Git integration; add zero packages and zero services.
dataFlow: Inputs remain in browser memory -> pure core functions -> DOM output. No persistence and no outbound network path.
securityBoundaries: no user content rendered as HTML
clipboard write only after user action
rollback: Revert the isolated assignment branch or discard the preview deployment; master remains unchanged.
